limitations: Sampled training telemetry is not a complete gradient history
Counters do not establish policy health or exclude transient bad behavior
No exact wall timestamps in training.jsonl; physical-experience axis only
Three frozen repetitions are not independent training seeds
References are reused rather than simultaneously randomized with the endpoint
Per-condition standard deviations are descriptive; no significance or superiority claim
Zero decision cost provides no explicit optimization target for reducing calls
